In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover a two major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
Story 1: India’s New Energy Security Dilemma
We will look into how India is balancing two parallel energy strategies — rapidly expanding renewable energy while also investing heavily in oil refineries. The story explores how energy security is changing in an electrifying world, the challenges of financing clean energy, and why fossil fuels still remain important despite the green transition.
